The *Amarādevīpañhajātaka* (Ja 112), also titled *Amarādevīpañha*, is a short entry within the Pali Jātaka collection [Fausböll 1877]. The text opens with the verse line *Yena sattubilangā cā* ("Cakes and gruel") [Fausböll 1877]. Rather than presenting an extended narrative in place, the traditional commentary indicates that this riddle or narrative concerning Queen Amarā will appear fully in the *Ummaggajātaka* (*Ayam Amarādevīpañho nāma tatth' eva avibhavissati*) [Fausböll 1877].
